english_meaning: Light, fine rain falling in very small drops.
gujarati_meaning: હળવો, ઝીણો વરસાદ — જ્યારે ખૂબ નાના ટીપાં ધીમે ધીમે પડે છે.
usage_note: Used for very light rain; less intense than a shower.
examples: There was a light drizzle this morning.
We walked through the drizzle without umbrellas.
The drizzle made the roads slippery.
A gentle drizzle fell on the garden.

english_meaning: A heavy and sudden fall of rain.
gujarati_meaning: અચાનક અને ભારે વરસાદ — જ્યારે ખૂબ ઝડપથી ઘણો વરસાદ પડે.
usage_note: Implies a sudden, intense burst of rain, often unexpected.
memory_tip: 'Down' = નીચે + 'pour' = રેડવું → ઉપરથી ઘણો વરસાદ રેડાય.
examples: We were caught in a sudden downpour.
The downpour flooded the streets within minutes.
A downpour interrupted the outdoor wedding.
After the downpour, the sky cleared up.

english_meaning: Covered with clouds; dull and grey sky.
gujarati_meaning: આકાશ વાદળોથી ઢંકાયેલું — ધૂંધળું અને રાખોડી રંગનું આકાશ.
usage_note: Describes a sky completely covered by cloud with no sun visible.
examples: The sky was overcast all day.
An overcast morning turned into heavy rain.
We postponed the picnic because it was overcast.
The overcast weather made everyone feel gloomy.

english_meaning: Having a high level of moisture in the air; damp and warm.
gujarati_meaning: હવામાં ભેજ વધારે હોય — ગરમ અને ભેજવાળી હવા.
usage_note: Often used with 'hot' to describe uncomfortable tropical weather.
memory_tip: 'Humid' → humidity → ભેજ. ભેજ = ભારે ગરમી + ભેજ.
examples: Mumbai is extremely humid in summer.
The humid air made it hard to breathe.
We prefer dry heat over humid conditions.
The humid weather caused the wood to swell.

english_meaning: Very dry, with little or no rainfall; barren.
gujarati_meaning: ખૂબ શુષ્ક — જ્યાં વરસાદ ભાગ્યે જ પડે અને વનસ્પતિ ઓછી હોય.
usage_note: Used to describe very dry climates or regions like deserts.
examples: The Sahara is one of the most arid regions on Earth.
Few plants can survive in such arid conditions.
The arid soil cracked under the scorching sun.
Water conservation is essential in arid climates.

english_meaning: A very strong wind, typically reaching 50–100 km/h.
gujarati_meaning: ખૂબ જોરદાર પવન — સામાન્ય રીતે ૫૦ થી ૧૦૦ કિ.મી./કલાકની ઝડપે ફૂંકાય.
usage_note: A gale is stronger than a breeze but weaker than a hurricane.
examples: The gale knocked down several trees.
Sailors were warned about gale-force winds.
The gale made walking outdoors dangerous.
A gale swept through the coastal town overnight.

english_meaning: A thin layer of ice crystals that forms on surfaces when temperature drops below freezing.
gujarati_meaning: ઠંડીમાં સપાટી પર જામેલા બરફના ઝીણા સ્ફટિક — જ્યારે તાપમાન શૂન્ય ડિગ્રી નીચે જાય.
usage_note: Frost appears overnight and melts after sunrise; affects crops badly.
memory_tip: 'Frost' → 'ફ્રોઝ' (freeze) → freeze = જામી ગયેલ → frost = જામેલ બરફ.
examples: A heavy frost damaged the crops overnight.
The grass was covered with frost in the morning.
Frost warnings were issued for the region.
The frost made the roads slippery.

english_meaning: A mixture of rain and snow, or partly melted snow falling as icy pellets.
gujarati_meaning: વરસાદ અને બરફ ભેગા પડે — અડધા ઓગળેલા બરફના ઝીણા ટુકડા જ્યારે પડે.
usage_note: Common in cold temperate climates; different from hail which is larger.
examples: The forecast predicted sleet for the weekend.
Sleet made driving conditions very hazardous.
Children were disappointed when snow turned to sleet.
The sleet stung our faces as we walked.

english_meaning: A prolonged period of abnormally hot weather.
gujarati_meaning: લાંબા સમય સુધી ચાલુ રહેતી અસામાન્ય ગરમ હવામાનની સ્થિતિ.
usage_note: A heatwave lasts several days and poses serious health risks.
examples: A severe heatwave struck northern India last June.
Hospitals were overwhelmed during the heatwave.
The heatwave caused widespread power outages.
Farmers suffered huge losses due to the heatwave.

english_meaning: A severe snowstorm with strong winds and low visibility.
gujarati_meaning: ભારે બરફ અને જોરદાર પવન સાથે આવતું ભીષણ હિમ-તોફાન — જ્યાં કાંઈ દેખાય નહીં.
usage_note: A blizzard requires winds of at least 56 km/h with snow reducing visibility.
examples: A blizzard paralyzed the city for three days.
Rescue teams struggled through blizzard conditions.
The blizzard left over a metre of snow.
Schools were closed during the blizzard.

english_meaning: A thick cloud of tiny water droplets near the ground reducing visibility.
gujarati_meaning: જમીન પાસે ઝીણા પાણીના ટીપાંનો ઘટ્ટ ગુચ્છ — જેથી આગળ ઓછું દેખાય.
usage_note: Fog differs from mist by having visibility below 1 km.
memory_tip: 'Fog' → 'ફ' = ફસાઈ ગયા (got stuck) → ફૉગમાં ફસાઈ જવાય.
examples: Dense fog caused several accidents on the highway.
The fog lifted by mid-morning.
Flights were delayed due to heavy fog.
The old lighthouse guided ships through the fog.

english_meaning: Unpleasantly warm and damp; oppressively humid.
gujarati_meaning: અગવડ ભરી ગરમ અને ભેજવાળી હવા — જ્યારે શ્વાસ લેવો પણ ભારે લાગે.
usage_note: Informal word often used to describe tropical monsoon weather.
examples: The muggy afternoon made everyone feel lethargic.
It was too muggy to enjoy the outdoor festival.
A muggy breeze offered no real relief.
The muggy climate of Kerala takes getting used to.

english_meaning: Having a light, refreshing wind blowing.
gujarati_meaning: હળવો, તાજો પવન ફૂંકાતો હોય — ઠંડક આપનારો.
usage_note: Breezy implies a pleasant, light wind — unlike windy which can be unpleasant.
memory_tip: 'Breeze' = ઠંડો પવન → 'breezy' = ઠંડો પવન વાળો દિવસ.
examples: A breezy afternoon made the beach perfect.
The breezy weather was ideal for flying kites.
She wore a light scarf on the breezy morning.
The breezy hilltop offered a stunning view.

english_meaning: Any form of water — rain, snow, sleet — that falls from clouds to the ground.
gujarati_meaning: વાદળોમાંથી જમીન પર પડતું કોઈ પણ સ્વરૂપનું પાણી — વરસાદ, બરફ, કે ઝીણા બરફ.
usage_note: Scientific/meteorological term used in weather reports and geography.
memory_tip: 'Precipi-' = ઝડપથી પડવું → precipitation = આકાશમાંથી ઝડપથી પડતું પાણી.
examples: The region receives over 2000 mm of precipitation annually.
Low precipitation has led to drought conditions.
Meteorologists measure precipitation using rain gauges.
The precipitation this winter was mostly in the form of snow.

english_meaning: The loud rumbling or crashing sound heard during a thunderstorm, caused by lightning.
gujarati_meaning: વીજળી ચમકે ત્યારે સંભળાતો ભારે ગડગડાટ — ગૂઢ મોટો અવાજ.
usage_note: Thunder is the sound; lightning is the light. They occur together in storms.
examples: The children hid under the blanket at the thunder.
A loud clap of thunder woke everyone up.
Thunder rolled across the mountains.
We heard distant thunder as the storm approached.

english_meaning: A violently rotating column of air extending from a thunderstorm to the ground.
gujarati_meaning: ગર્જનાતોફાનમાંથી જમીન સુધી ફૂંકાતો ઝડપભેર ફરતો હવાનો સ્તંભ — અત્યંત વિનાશકારી.
usage_note: Tornadoes are measured on the Enhanced Fujita (EF) scale from EF0 to EF5.
examples: A tornado destroyed dozens of homes in the town.
Residents took shelter as a tornado warning was issued.
The tornado left a path of destruction 2 km wide.
Scientists study tornadoes to improve early warning systems.

english_meaning: The distance one can see clearly, especially in relation to weather conditions.
gujarati_meaning: હવામાનમાં કેટલે દૂર સ્પષ્ટ દેખી શકાય — ખાસ કરીને ધુમ્મસ, ધૂળ કે વરસાદ વખતે.
usage_note: Used heavily in aviation, marine, and road safety contexts.
examples: Fog reduced visibility to less than 50 metres.
Pilots reported poor visibility at the airport.
Visibility improved once the rain stopped.
Low visibility caused a multi-car accident on the highway.

english_meaning: A seasonal wind bringing heavy rainfall, especially in South and Southeast Asia.
gujarati_meaning: ઋતુ-પ્રમાણે ફૂંકાતો પવન — ખાસ કરીને ભારત-એશિયામાં ભારે વરસાদ લઈ આવે.
usage_note: In India, the southwest monsoon arrives around June and retreats by October.
examples: The monsoon arrived two weeks early this year.
Farmers eagerly await the monsoon season.
Heavy monsoon rains flooded low-lying areas.
The monsoon is essential for India's agriculture.

english_meaning: The time when the sun crosses the equator, making day and night equal in length.
gujarati_meaning: જ્યારે સૂર્ય વિષુવવૃત્ત પર હોય — દિવસ અને રાત સરખી લંબાઈ ધરાવે.
usage_note: Occurs twice a year: around March 20 and September 23.
examples: The spring equinox marks the start of astronomical spring.
On the equinox, day and night are each 12 hours long.
Many cultures celebrate the autumn equinox.
The equinox occurs around March 20 each year.

english_meaning: Either of the two times of year when the sun reaches its furthest point north or south, giving the longest or shortest day.
gujarati_meaning: વર્ષમાં બે વખત — જ્યારે સૂર્ય સૌથી ઉત્તર અથવા દક્ષિણ બિંદુ પર હોય — સૌથી લાંબો કે ટૂંકો દિવસ.
usage_note: Summer solstice (~June 21) is the longest day; winter solstice (~Dec 21) the shortest.
memory_tip: 'Sol' = સૂર્ય (sun) + 'stice' = ઊભા રહેવું → સૂર્ય જ્યાં ઊભો રહે.
examples: The summer solstice is celebrated with bonfires in many cultures.
June 21 is the winter solstice in the Southern Hemisphere.
The solstice marks an important point in the astronomical calendar.
Stonehenge was built to align with the summer solstice sunrise.

english_meaning: Having a mild climate without extremes of heat or cold.
gujarati_meaning: સૌમ્ય આબોહવા — ન ખૂબ ગરમ, ન ખૂબ ઠંડી — સામાન્ય, અનુકૂળ હવામાન.
usage_note: The temperate zones lie between the tropics and the polar regions.
examples: Britain has a temperate maritime climate.
Temperate forests support a wide variety of wildlife.
The temperate zone experiences four distinct seasons.
Grapes grow well in temperate climates.

english_meaning: Relating to regions adjacent to the tropics, with hot summers and mild winters.
gujarati_meaning: ઉષ્ણકટિબંધ નજીકના પ્રદેશ — ગરમ ઉનાળો અને સૌમ્ય શિયાળો ધરાવે.
usage_note: Gujarat and parts of western India have a subtropical climate.
examples: Gujarat has a subtropical climate with hot summers.
Subtropical regions experience heavy monsoon rainfall.
Many citrus fruits thrive in subtropical climates.
The subtropical zone lies between the tropics and temperate regions.

english_meaning: In a state of rest or inactivity; temporarily inactive (used of plants, animals, or volcanoes).
gujarati_meaning: આરામ કે નિષ્ક્રિયતાની અવસ્થામાં — ઋતુ પ્રમાણે ઘણા છોડ, પ્રાણી કે જ્વાળામુખી નિષ્ક્રિય રહે.
usage_note: Used in biology for plants in winter and animals in hibernation.
examples: Many plants remain dormant during the cold winter months.
The volcano had been dormant for over a century.
Seeds lie dormant in the soil until spring arrives.
Bears become dormant during hibernation.

english_meaning: Lasting or existing for a long or apparently infinite time; (of plants) living for several years.
gujarati_meaning: ઘણા વર્ષો સુધી જીવતો/ચાલુ રહેતો — (છોડ માટે) દર વર્ષે ફૂલ આપે.
usage_note: In gardening, perennials return every year; annuals last only one season.
examples: Roses are popular perennial garden plants.
Flooding is a perennial problem in low-lying areas.
Perennial rivers flow throughout the year.
This perennial grass survives drought and frost.

english_meaning: To melt or cause to melt from ice or snow; to become warmer after winter.
gujarati_meaning: બરફ ઓગળવો — ઠંડી ઘટ્યા પછી બરફ ઓગળે અથવા ઠંડા ખોરાક/વ્યક્તિ ગરમ થઈ જાય.
usage_note: Also used figuratively: 'relations between countries began to thaw.'
examples: The ice on the lake began to thaw in March.
Frozen pipes thawed after the temperature rose.
The spring thaw flooded the meadows.
She left the meat out to thaw before cooking.

english_meaning: A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall leading to water shortage.
gujarati_meaning: ઘણા સમય સુધી ઓછો વરસાદ — જળ-સંકટ ઊભો થાય.
usage_note: Drought affects agriculture, water supply, and ecosystems.
examples: The region suffered its worst drought in 50 years.
Drought forced many farmers to abandon their crops.
The government declared a drought emergency.
Drought-resistant crops are vital in arid regions.

english_meaning: A violent, windy storm.
gujarati_meaning: ભારે પવન અને વરસાদ સાથેનું ભીષણ તોફાન.
usage_note: Mostly literary/poetic; 'A tempest in a teapot' means a big fuss over something small.
examples: The sailors feared the tempest would sink their ship.
Shakespeare's play 'The Tempest' features a magical storm.
The tempest lasted three days and caused widespread damage.
A tempest of emotions swept through the crowd.

english_meaning: The typical weather conditions of a region over a long period.
gujarati_meaning: કોઈ પ્રદેશની લાંબા સમય સુધીની સામાન્ય હવામાન-પ્રકૃતિ — આબોહવા.
usage_note: Climate is long-term patterns; weather is day-to-day conditions.
memory_tip: 'Climate' → ક = કાયમ (permanent) → કાયમ ની હવા = આબોહવા.
examples: India has a tropical climate in most regions.
Climate change is one of the biggest global challenges.
The Mediterranean climate is ideal for olive growing.
Scientists study climate patterns to predict future weather.

english_meaning: Relating to spring; fresh and young.
gujarati_meaning: વસંત ઋતુ સાથે સંબંધિત — તાજો, નવો, ઉત્સાહભર્યો.
usage_note: Mostly used in formal or poetic contexts to refer to spring.
examples: The vernal equinox occurs around March 20.
Vernal flowers bloomed across the meadow.
The air had a vernal freshness after the long winter.
Vernal pools are temporary ponds that form in spring.

english_meaning: Relating to autumn; characteristic of autumn.
gujarati_meaning: પાનખર ઋતુ સંબંધી — જ્યારે પાંદડાં ખરે અને ઠંડી શરૂ થાય.
usage_note: Used in poetic or formal contexts for autumn.
examples: The park was bathed in autumnal colours of red and gold.
An autumnal chill filled the evening air.
The autumnal equinox marks the start of fall.
Autumnal festivals celebrate the harvest season.

english_meaning: Ground that remains permanently frozen, found in polar and subarctic regions.
gujarati_meaning: ધ્રુવ પ્રદેશોમાં સ્થાયી રૂપે જામેલ ભૂમિ — ક્યારેય ઓગળતી નથી.
usage_note: Thawing permafrost due to climate change releases greenhouse gases.
examples: Permafrost covers about 25% of the Earth's land surface.
Melting permafrost is accelerating climate change.
Buildings in Siberia are constructed on permafrost.
Ancient organisms have been found preserved in permafrost.

english_meaning: The recurring process of water evaporating, forming clouds, and falling as precipitation.
gujarati_meaning: પાણી બાષ્પ બને, વાદળ બને, અને ફરી વરસાદ/બરફ રૂપે પડે — આ ફરી ફરી ચાલતી પ્રક્રિયા.
usage_note: Also called the hydrological cycle; fundamental to Earth's climate system.
memory_tip: 'Cycle' = ચક્ર → precipitation cycle = વરસાદ-ચક્ર = water cycle.
examples: The precipitation cycle is essential for life on Earth.
Deforestation disrupts the natural precipitation cycle.
Students learn about the precipitation cycle in geography.
The precipitation cycle distributes fresh water across the planet.

english_meaning: (Of trees) shedding leaves seasonally, especially in autumn.
gujarati_meaning: (વૃક્ષ) જે ઋતુ-ક્રમ અનુસાર — ખાસ પાનખરમાં — પાંદડાં ખેરવે.
usage_note: Contrasted with evergreen trees that keep their leaves year-round.
memory_tip: 'Decide' + '-uous' → deciduous = (ઋતુ) નક્કી કરે ત્યારે પાન ખરે.
examples: Oak and maple are common deciduous trees.
Deciduous forests are stunning in autumn colours.
Deciduous trees lose their leaves to conserve water in winter.
The park is dominated by deciduous woodland.

english_meaning: The pressure exerted by the atmosphere at any point, used in weather forecasting.
gujarati_meaning: વાયુ-મંડળ જે દબાણ ઊભું કરે — હવામાનની આગાહી માટે ઉપયોગી.
usage_note: Low pressure usually brings rain; high pressure brings clear skies.
examples: Falling barometric pressure signals an approaching storm.
Weather forecasters monitor barometric pressure closely.
A sudden drop in barometric pressure preceded the typhoon.
Barometric pressure is measured in millibars or hectopascals.
